ModMetaData.name: ChickenBatteryCage
ModMetaData.author: hopeseekr
ModMetaData.description:
RimWorld chicken battery cages that keep huge chicken flocks without game lag. World hunger solved??
Unlock confined poultry husbandry in the medieval era, then build a four-tier 2×3 cage from wood, steel, or glitterworld metals. Animal handlers lead hens here automatically, ahead of ordinary pens. Housed hens are managed as a flock. Must be fully roofed.
